user_stories.title: Create mi_all_pattern gen_yawl module
acceptance_criteria: Module compiles without errors: rebar3 compile
Implements all gen_yawl callbacks (place_lst, trsn_lst, init_marking, preset, is_enabled, fire, trigger)
Supports arbitrary instance count M (not hardcoded to 4)
Petri net structure is sound (option to complete, proper completion, no dead transitions)
XES logging events emitted for spawn, complete, and sync
fire/3 returns 3-tuple {produce, Map, NewState} for state updates
Follows n_out_of_m.erl structure and conventions
Doctests pass: erl -noshell -e "eunit:test(mi_all_pattern, [verbose])" -s init stop
user_stories.notes: Reference implementation: /Users/sac/cre/src/patterns/n_out_of_m.erl. Generalize multiple_instances_sync.erl to support any M.

user_stories.title: Create mi_first_n_pattern gen_yawl module
acceptance_criteria: Module compiles without errors
Implements all gen_yawl callbacks
Proceeds after first N instances complete (non-blocking downstream)
Continues processing remaining M-N instances after threshold
Result aggregation: return first N results immediately, all M at completion
Petri net includes p_proceed (trigger downstream) and p_all_done (track completion)
XES logging for threshold_met event
Follows n_out_of_m.erl structure
Doctests pass
user_stories.notes: New pattern - not based on existing code. Key innovation: split output into proceed and all_done.

user_stories.title: Create mi_discriminator_pattern gen_yawl module
acceptance_criteria: Module compiles without errors
Implements all gen_yawl callbacks
First completion wins, produces output immediately
trigger/3 callback cancels remaining instance tokens
Cancellation tokens propagate to instance execution
State tracks winner, cancelled instances
XES logging for winner selection and cancellation events
Integrates blocking_discriminator.erl logic
Doctests pass
user_stories.notes: Integrate blocking_discriminator.erl:83 logic into MI framework. Use trigger/3 for atomic cancellation.
